patronOf.en-US: Virgin of Lucca, lover of the Passion
patronOf.pt-BR: Virgem de Lucca, amante da Paixão

prayerExcerpt.en-US: "Jesus, make me like Thee; make me suffer with Thee."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Jesus, fazei-me semelhante a Vós; fazei-me sofrer convosco."

meta.face: A young woman of about twenty-two with a pale, clear complexion and a full OVAL face, broad at the cheekbones and tapering to a small, firm, rounded chin — a high smooth forehead, dark, straight, softly sloping brows, large, clear grey-brown eyes raised upward, a straight nose with a broad, rounded tip, a small mouth with full lips, closed; dark-brown hair parted in the centre and drawn smoothly back behind the ears to a knot at the nape, ears showing; the gaze lifted to heaven, rapt and calm.
meta.basis: Her photograph of September 1900 (Commons): an oval, full-cheeked face lifted upward, large light eyes, a broad-tipped nose, full lips, dark hair parted and drawn back, a black high-collared dress. Germanus says she dressed simply, without ornament, and kept her remarkably brilliant eyes lowered. The eye colour is not recorded (the photograph is monochrome); grey-brown is a guess.
meta.excerpt: Her prayer before the Crucifix, as Ven. Germanus of St. Stanislaus gives it in his Life of Gemma Galgani (English translation by A. M. O'Sullivan, 1913, public domain), shortened; pt-BR our rendering of the English (the Italian original was not found online)
